[[File:ForgottenSithTemple-EotEEtU.jpg|thumb|right|350px|A forgotten Sith Temple]]
{{Quote|Although the Sith species were experienced builders of monumental architecture, they certainly benefited from the instruction of the Sith Lords.|[[Seviss Vaa]] of the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]]|<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>}}
A '''Sith temple''' was a structure built by, or dedicated to, any of the various incarnations of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. Many temples were built over the millennia by the order as well as [[Galactic Empire/Legends|their]] [[Trade Federation/Legends|various]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|allies]].

Such temples stood on [[Thule/Legends|Thule]], [[Krant]], [[Hanoon|Geddes]], and countless other worlds with some association to the Sith.
